{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Obsessive-compulsive disorder''' was a condition that caused an individual to develop unnatural obsessions and compulsive behavior. These could include an intense interest in specific objects,<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> or the affected individual could display repetitive behavior, such as cleaning themselves and organizing items, even while in the company of others. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Hurrwarr]] was afflicted with this disorder and his constant preening and organization would sometimes drive away his clientele.<ref name="HitC">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds}}</ref> [[Murk Lundi]], a [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] historian, also suffered from obsessive-compulsive disorder, which triggered his obsession with locating a Sith [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obsessive-compulsive disorder first appeared in [[2001]], with the [[June]] publication of ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds|Head in the Clouds]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] role-playing adventure. The diagnostic criteria for the real-world disorder are similar to the symptoms displayed by Hurrwarr, in which the sufferer has recurrent and persistent thoughts and impulses that the individual may attempt to suppress with other thought patterns, along with displaying repetitive behavior, such as hand washing and ordering.<ref name="DSM-IV">''Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders'', Fourth Edition, pages 422-423&mdash;Diagnostic criteria for 300.3 Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder</ref><ref name="OCD">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmedhealth/PMH0001926|text=Obsessive-compulsive disorder|work=PubMed Health|archivedate=20110204171605}}</ref>
